question: Code Orange threshold (source: p.40 vs H&S 2 p.22)
recommendation: See program decision D1
assumed_answer: Code Orange = spill of 500 mL or more of a hazardous chemical/biological agent, OR any amount of a highly toxic, reactive, flammable or explosive substance, OR any spill the person cannot safely contain; smaller low-hazard spills are handled locally with the spill kit and reported to the cleaning supervisor. Drop the '< 1 L minor spill' wording.

Announcements: 'Code [colour] + location' and 'Code [colour] all clear'. All extensions except 2222 = placeholder until client confirms.

question: Radiation dose limits and bands (2 mSv / 3 months, 20 mSv / year; 1.25 / 1.25–3.75 / > 3.75 mSv) (source: p.59)
recommendation: Confirm against current national regulation and facility policy; confirm whether the bands are per quarter
assumed_answer: Occupational effective dose limit 20 mSv/year averaged over 5 years (100 mSv/5 y, no single year > 50 mSv); public 1 mSv/year; lens of eye 20 mSv/year; pregnant worker 1 mSv to the fetus for the rest of the pregnancy. Treat 1.25 and 3.75 mSv as per-quarter ALARA investigation levels (Level I review / Level II investigation), not dose limits; drop '2 mSv / 3 months' unless the RSO confirms it is a facility action level.
